v23_runtime.retained_U_replay: every admitted U in each joint patient forward
v23_runtime.U_order: frozen native comparison.centers bank; coverage order, not claimed difficulty order
v23_runtime.donor: native seed42 fixed independent inner-train donor for each patient
v23_runtime.ranking_loss: softplus(U-P): mean U, then mean P within patient, then mean patients
v23_runtime.stage_metrics: each P ranked against active U only; mean P then mean patient
v23_runtime.best_metrics: same per-P patient-macro MRR on fixed all-P+128U, then top1, then negative pairwise loss
v23_runtime.zero_P_training: retain population; P-versus-U ranking undefined and excluded explicitly
v23_runtime.zero_P_validation: all zero-P patients scored; exclude only undefined P ranking denominators
v23_runtime.target_management_description: existing frozen native bank order; cumulative admission and replay
v23_runtime.patient_target_order: original seeded random patient order; all patients once
